comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: Brazil really does feel like several countries compressed into one. 🇧🇷🌎 The Amazon, Pantanal, Lençóis Maranhenses, Atlantic Forest and southern highlands all operate under completely different climates and ecosystems. That geographic diversity also helps explain why regional cultures, food and ways of life can vary so dramatically across the country.
